title: Implement PhysicalActionProposal schema and taxonomy classifier
verify: PhysicalActionProposal strict schemas reject unknown properties and unsafe raw/provider/UI authority sources.
Classifier covers pH/EC, solution, nutrient dosing, device/environment, manual intervention, and unknown physical intervention categories.
Proposal creation does not create Approval, action_task, or device command records.
evidence_required: unit test output for proposal schema validation and taxonomy classifier
negative tests for raw model output, UI Feed, raw chat, governance, and AgentMemoryRecord authority bypass
redaction evidence for candidate wording persistence/display
constraints: PhysicalActionProposal is a typed proposal, not approval or execution.
Strict schemas reject unknown properties for safety-sensitive proposals.
Raw provider output, hidden reasoning, UI Feed, raw chat, unapproved governance content, and AgentMemoryRecord cannot become proposal authority.
No automated actuation tool, command, or side effect may be introduced.
invariants: The model proposes and the harness/backend validates, authorizes, records, and returns structured observations.
Physical-action advice must pass Safety Gate and authorized human approval before cleared action wording or action_task.
Fresh data is never sufficient by itself for physical action.
verification_targets: no Approval/action_task/device command on proposal creation
